features.name: Browser-based IDE
features.detail: Service: tree/read/write with stale-base (409) and path/forbidden/.git guards, tested (40 pytest). No full IDE UI built: only the review surface (ReviewPanel) exists; the existing CodeMirror editor is not wired to this service.

features.name: Inline diff review
features.detail: Per-hunk accept/reject/comment: service decisions + apply with rejected-hunk integrity, pending never applied, stale-base block, rollback on failure, idempotent apply; ReviewPanel UI exercised in real Chromium against the real service (keyboard-only flow, on-disk result checked). Not verified against a live S5 sandbox or real users.

features.name: Inline code actions
features.detail: Service actions: references (needs S11 context, fails closed if absent), blame (git log -L), add-tests (produces a reviewable change set, never a direct write). explain/refactor return unsupported + NEEDS_INTEGRATION with an exact A2 proposal. No selection-driven action menu in the UI.

features.name: Composer-style multi-file editing
features.detail: Multi-file change sets with per-file/hunk curation and atomic all-or-nothing apply are verified locally (incl. disjoint same-file edit merge, overlap rejection). Agent/SDK-produced edits are not fed into change sets: NEEDS INTEGRATION with A2 run output.

features.name: Agent chat anchored to code lines
features.detail: Line/range comments anchored by content hash with anchored/drifted/orphaned status, team-scoped, author/admin delete — tested. No chat/agent conversation bound to the anchor and no comment UI.

features.name: Automatic merge checks
features.state: VERIFIED IMPLEMENTED (local evidence gate); branch protection NEEDS EXTERNAL VALIDATION
features.detail: merge-checks reports gates (decisions complete, change set applied, verification evidence bound to the current tree fingerprint, sandbox checkpoint). mergeAction is 'not-available-by-design' and no merge route exists (tested). Provider branch protection remains an operator action.

risks.note: Per-hunk review is keyboard-first with explicit blockers; no usability study run.
Time-to-first-useful-change not measured with real developers.
Browser review surface only; IDE entry points are S3.
Review/merge-evidence gates local; no live provider journey.
Merge checks are evidence-only (no extra approval ceremony) but overhead is unmeasured.
